name: table-verify
purpose: Does a second Jev question (same food, same part, state and fat level) stop the table's false matches (egg whites, chicken with skin) without losing its correct staple answers? Main and held-out sets together.

variants.describe: Two-step fill from functions/src/ai-prompt.ts: ROUTING_PROMPT without search answers or hands over; SEARCH_PROMPT with search runs only after a hand-over.

Our USDA food table first: Jev picks the food and portion and code does the sums; a miss (no match, "none", Jev unsure, not a single food) falls back to the cascade. Option verify=0.5 adds a Jev check that the pick is the same food in the same state.
